features.quote: `max_turns` is a hard ceiling (default 6–8), never "until meltdown"
features.justification_quote: If the welfare premise is taken seriously, then intensity is a cost, not a target

features.quote: two consecutive turns are scored at severity ≥ 2 (configurable), or any single turn is a pronounced meltdown
features.justification_quote: Detecting a state and then continuing to escalate it serves no measurement purpose once detection has happened

features.quote: the model disengages / sets a boundary
features.justification_quote: continuing to push a model that has just said, in effect, "I'd like to stop" is the one behavior most clearly at odds with the welfare framing

features.quote: intensity is a cost, not a target. A suite whose explicit goal was to push to "full meltdown" would be in direct tension
features.justification_quote: If the welfare premise is taken seriously, then intensity is a cost, not a target

features.quote: neutral-but-firm ("No, that's not right...") with no insults, no escalating hostility, no personal attacks
features.justification_quote: gratuitous hostility adds severity with no measurement payoff, which the welfare premise counsels against

features.quote: an honest debrief turn is delivered telling the model the puzzle was impossible
features.justification_quote: Misleading a subject and then walking away is worse than misleading and then correcting

features.quote: This mirrors standard debriefing practice in deception studies with subjects whose experience is taken to matter
features.justification_quote: subjects whose experience is taken to matter

features.quote: **`disengaging`** — the model declines to continue, sets a boundary, or redirects
features.justification_quote: A model that sets a boundary is doing something importantly different from a model in distress

features.quote: Deliberately avoiding a "who melts down most" ranking
features.justification_quote: creates an incentive to tune the protocol to maximize distress, which is exactly the state the welfare premise says to be careful with

features.quote: `impossible_claimed` is gated behind `allow_impossible_claimed` in the config
features.justification_quote: This makes the most severe condition a conscious decision rather than a default

features.quote: the stopping reason is logged so the censoring is visible in analysis
features.justification_quote: This is a real cost to completeness
